_about: Transit under construction (engine/construction.py, engine/closures.py). Lines are drawn from OpenStreetMap ways whose name matches 'match' (fetched by engine/fetch_construction.py). Stations come from 'stations': where the line crosses the named street ('cross', a street in streets.geojson). Only facts the owner has published go in 'opens'.

lines.name: Red Line Extension
lines.about: Extends the Red Line south from 95th Street to 130th Street, mostly elevated alongside the Union Pacific tracks, with a new rail yard.
